name: IMR90_25kb_multicaller_union
role: CrediTAD downstream evidence-card demo — boundaries NOT called by CrediTAD
candidate_definition: deduplicated union of the six panel callers' domain endpoints, snapped to the bin grid; no ConsensusTAD involved
upstream_pipeline: local multi-caller run (OnTAD level-2, SpectralTAD level-1, TopDom, MSTD v1, Arrowhead Juicer 1.22.01 with SCALE balancing, DI domaincaller); cooler ICE for Hi-C. Parameter CHOICES follow Li et al. Nat Methods 2026 where obtainable; this is a local panel, not a byte-reproduction of TADShop. Method-level limitations: docs/MEASURED_LIMITATIONS.md.

source.md5_match: exact, whole file; no hg19 copy is kept in this repository

loop_calls.transform: hg19 -> hg38 with pyliftover and UCSC hg19ToHg38.over.chain.gz; both loop-anchor midpoints mapped, anchor width preserved (GM12878) or all four endpoints mapped independently (IMR90); loops whose anchors do not map are dropped
loop_calls.transform_reproduced: byte-identical; 7 of 8,040 loops dropped as unmappable
loop_calls.known_artefact: 11 rows (0.137%) carry a non-positive anchor width and 7 rows (0.087%) have y1 < x1; both are introduced by the four-endpoint chain mapping and are absent from the hg19 original

reference_note: TAD boundaries have no ground truth; this package is caller output graded by evidence, not a validated boundary set.
